title: Will FaZe win a Tier 1 event in 2026?
description:

title: Will CS2 Add a Shootout OT by December 31?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if Valve officially implements a shootout-based overtime format for Premier mode in Counter-Strike 2 on or before December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

Unofficial modifications, third-party or tournament-specific rule sets, community server configurations, and datamined or unreleased changes that are not part of a published official update will not count.

The primary resolution source will be Valve's official Counter-Strike 2 patch notes and update announcements, however a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

title: Will ArrowCS eat a bug on stream by December 31?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if ArrowCS eats a bug during any livestreams between market creation and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

"Eating a bug" refers to ArrowCS placing any part of the body of an insect or other arthropod (such as a cricket, ant, beetle, or similar) into his mouth and closing his mouth during a live broadcast.

A qualifying bug may be alive, dead, cooked, raw, or otherwise prepared provided it is a recognizable part of the body of an insect or other arthropod.

The relevant part of the body of an insect or other arthropod must be a discrete item and retain its original physical form. Processed or insect-derived products, such as insect flour, protein bars, or snacks containing ground insects, will not count. 

ArrowCS must close his mouth with the relevant bug inside, defined as his two lips being completely shut. Merely holding, licking, or placing a bug in the mouth without closure will not count. If he later removes the bug from his mouth after a qualifying action, that will have no bearing on resolution of this market.

The full act as described above must be clearly broadcast on a livestream to qualify. Pre-recorded or edited footage that is not part of a live broadcast will not count.

The resolution source for this market will be qualifying livestream footage.

title: Will ropz Get Pulled Over Again in 2026?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if Robin "ropz" Kool is pulled over by law enforcement between market creation and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

Stops at fixed checkpoints or border crossings, stops of vehicles in which ropz is a passenger rather than the driver will not count toward a "Yes" resolution for this market.

A statement by ropz will qualify only if it explicitly describes a stop that actually occurred; jokes, memes, or hypothetical references will not qualify.

If a qualifying stop occurs within the window, this market will resolve to "Yes" once it is publicly confirmed. A qualifying stop that is not publicly confirmed by January 14, 2027, 11:59 PM ET will not qualify, and if no qualifying stop has been confirmed by that time this market will resolve to "No".

The primary resolution source for this market will be public statements from ropz and/or local, state, or federal law enforcement; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

title: Which teams will qualify to PGL Major Singapore 2026?
description:
The PGL Major Singapore 2026 is scheduled to take place from November 24 to December 13, 2026.

This market will resolve according to which teams qualify for the PGL Major Singapore 2026. If the listed team officially qualifies as one of the teams invited to the PGL Major Singapore 2026, the market will resolve to "Yes". Otherwise, it will resolve to "No".

Qualification to any stage of the Major (Stage 1, Stage 2, or Stage 3) will count. Invitations are expected to be issued based on the Valve Regional Standings (VRS); a team's projected or current VRS ranking alone will not count until the official invited team list is published. Ties in standings will be broken according to the official PGL / Valve rules.

If the PGL Major Singapore 2026 is canceled, postponed indefinitely, or if the official list of PGL Major Singapore 2026 participants is not published by January 12, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "No".

The primary resolution source will be official information from PGL (https://www.pglesports.com/cs2/pgl-major-singapore-2026/). However, a consensus of credible reporting (e.g., Liquipedia at https://liquipedia.net/counterstrike/PGL/2026/Singapore) may also be used.
